title: Ranking of tactics by a tactic model
description: What a tactic model says about one goal: for each candidate tactic the template it was read as and the probability the model gives it among the candidates, which add up to one, and for the goal a value, the model's estimate of the chance that the next tactic closes a goal. When the candidates are those of the step-wise search, each also has the prior the search gives it and the prior it has after the guide weighed it. The candidates come most probable first. A ranking is advice on the order of a search; nothing in it was checked by Lean.
